green_index.method: Manually assigned demo score, independent of calculated period change

provenance.method: Pattern-level synthesis for one fictional person; no original routes, merchants, identities or raw rows published. Conflicting diaries are not concatenated. Inventory is not charged as daily purchases.
rules: All activity timestamps, prices, coordinates and quantities are fictional.
One coherent fictional daily schedule, not an assertion that the original diaries belong to one person.
Household electricity allocated one third; personal shower allocated fully.
Product footprints booked once at purchase; no daily asset amortization.
Demo factors are labelled; MTR factor is published but its activity inputs remain synthetic.
Top-ups excluded; missing items/mode have unknown emissions.
Cold-water factor excludes heating; separately listed energy subtotals do not overlap.

factors.source: MTR Sustainable Finance Report 2025, heavy rail operational GHG per passenger-km
